spans.s:
शण् शण्, cl. 1. or 10. P. शणति, शण-
यति, -यितुम्, to give; to go (?).

शण, अम्, n. hemp, Cannabis Sativa; (अस्), m. a
kind of hemp (commonly called Bengal Śaṇ; also
Crotolaria Juncea); an arrow, (in this sense perhaps
connected with शर); [cf. Gr. κάνναβις; Lat. can-
nabis; Lith. kanápe†; Russ. kanopla; Hib. ca-
naib; Old Iceland. hanp; Angl. Sax. hœnep;
Old Germ. hanaf; Mod. Germ. hanf.]
—शण-
घण्टिका, f. = शण-पुष्पी.
—शण-तन्तु, उस्, m.
thread or string made of the flax of the Crotolaria
Juncea.
—शण-तान्तव (?), अस्, ई, अम्, made of
hempen string.
—शण-पर्णी, f. the tree Pentaptera
Tomentosa.
—शण-पुष्पी or शण-पुष्पिका, f.
Crotolaria of various species.
—शण-शकल, अस्, m. a
piece of hemp.
—शण-सूत्र, अम्, n. the fibre or flax
of Śaṇ or hemp, hempen cord or string; a net made
of hemp; the thread of the Crotolaria Juncea;
cordage, twine.
—शणसूत्र-मय, अस्, ई, अम्,
consisting of hempen threads or cord.

शाण 1. शाण, अस्, ई, m. f. (fr. rt. शो), a
whetstone, grindstone; touchstone [cf. शान]; a saw;
[cf. Gr. κῶνο-ς, κωνίο-ν, κωνί-ς; Lat. cuneu-s; Engl.
hone; Old Norse hein; Angl. Sax. hœnan.]
—शाणा-
जीव (˚ण-आज्˚), अस्, m. ‘living by a whetstone,’ an
armourer.
—शाणाश्म-घर्षण (˚ण-अश्˚), अम्, n.
rubbing (anything) on a touchstone or whetstone.

शाण 2. शाण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. शण), made of
hemp or Bengal flax, hempen, flaxen; (अस्, ई), m. f.
a weight of four Māṣas; (अम्), n. cloth made of
hemp, coarse cloth, sack-cloth, canvas; a hempen
garment; (ई), f. a hempen cloth or garment; a new
unseamed and single breadth of cloth (given to a
student at his investiture for his upper garment),
ragged or torn raiment; coarse or tattered clothes
given to a Jaina ascetic at his initiation; a small
tent or screen (especially one used as a retiring-room
for actors, tumblers, &c.); gesture, gesticulation,
making signs with the hands or eyes.

शणालु, उस्, or शणालुक, अस्, m. the tree Cassia
Fistula (= आरेवत).
शणिका, f. = शण-पुष्पी above.

शणीर शणीर, अम्, n. a bank or alluvial
island in the middle of the river Śoṇa; an insular
spot enclosed by the branches of the river Surjoo at
the point where it falls into the Ganges above Chu-
pra, (this spot is also called Dardarī-taṭa, ‘Dardarī-
bank.’)

शाणीर शाणीर, अम्, n. (according to Śabda-
k.) a bank in the Śoṇa river (or, according to some,
in the river Dardarī).

शण्ठ शण्ठ, अस्, m. a eunuch (= शण्ढ,
q. v.).
शण्ड, अस्, m. (according to Uṇādi-s.

. fr.
rt. शण्ड् above), a eunuch; an impotent man; a
bull; a bull at liberty; N. of an Asura priest (Ved.);
(अम्), n. a multitude of lotus-flowers.
—शण्ड-ता,
f. impotence, emasculation; the state of a bull or of
a bull at liberty.
—शण्डामर्क (˚ड-अम्˚) or (ac-
cording to others) शण्डा-मर्क, औ, m. du. Śaṇḍa
and Amarka or Marka, N. of two demons.
शाण्ड शाण्ड, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a king.
षण्ड षण्ड, अस्, m. (according to Uṇādi-s.

. fr. rt. 1. सन्; cf. शण्ड, शण्ढ), a bull; a
eunuch, (fourteen or even twenty classes are enume-
rated by some writers); a multitude, collection,
quantity, group, heap; a wood, thicket; N. of one
of Viṣṇu's guards or attendants, (also written शण्ड,
q. v.); (अस्, अम्), m. n. a flock (of goats &c.); a
quantity of lotuses.

सण्ड सण्ड, अस्, m. (= शण्ड, षण्ड), a
eunuch.
शण्डिक, आस्, m. pl., Ved. the descendants of Śaṇḍa.
षण्डिक, अस्, m. a proper N.
शण्डिल, अस्, m. (according to Uṇādi-s.

. fr.
rt. शण्ड्), N. of an ancient sage (ancestor of a par-
ticular family of Brāhmans); (आस्), m. pl., N. of a
Gotra or family.

शाण्डिल शाण्डिल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. शण्डिल),
descended from Śaṇḍila, q. v.

शण्ढ शण्ढ, अस्, m. (according to Uṇā-
di-s.

. fr. rt. 1. शम्), a eunuch; an attendant
in a harem or women's apartments; an impotent
man; a bull; a bull at liberty; a mad man, drunken
man; [cf. शण्ड, षण्ड, षण्ढ, &c.]

षण्ढ, अस्, m. a eunuch.
—षण्ढ-तिल, अस्,
m. barren sesamum.
—षण्ढ-त्व, अम्, n. the
being a eunuch.

शाणित, अस्, आ, अम्, sharpened on a grindstone,
whetted, ground.

शाणि, इस्, m. a plant from the fibres of which a
coarse cloth or cordage is prepared, Corchorus Oli-
torius (= पट्ट).
शाण्डिली-पुत्र, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a teacher.

शाण्डिली-मातृ, ता, f. a matron descended from
Śaṇḍila.

शाण्डिलेय, अस्, m. a descendant of Śaṇḍila or of
Śāṇḍilya.

शाण्डिल्य, अस्, -ली, अम्, descended from Śaṇḍila;
coming from Śāṇḍilya, composed by Śāṇḍilya; (अस्),
m., N. of a Muni or sage (from whom one of the
three principal families of the Kanouj or Kānyakubja
Brāhmans is said to be descended; he is the author
of a law-book and of the Bhakti-sūtras); a form of
Agni or fire; a kind of tree, Ægle Marmelos (=
विल्व).
—शाण्डिल्य-गोत्र, अम्, n. the family of
Śāṇḍilya.
—शाण्डिल्य-विद्या, f. the doctrine of Śāṇ-
ḍilya (in the Chāndogya Upaniṣad).
—शाण्डिल्य-
सूत्र, अम्, n. the aphorisms of Śāṇḍilya on faith
and devotion (= भक्ति-सूत्र).
शाण्डिल्यायन, अस्, m. a patronymic.
षण्डक, अस्, m. a eunuch.

षण्डाली, f. a wanton woman; a pond, pool; a
particular measure of oil (commonly called Chatāk).

षाण्मातुर षाण्मातुर, अस्, m. (fr. षष् + मा-
तृ), ‘having six mothers,’ epithet of Kārttikeya, q. v.

षाण्मासिक षाण्मासिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. षण्-
मास), six-monthly, half-yearly, six months old, of
six months standing, lasting six months.

षाण्मास्य, &c. = षाण्मासिक; [cf. षण्मा-
स्य.]

सणसूत्र सण-सूत्र, अम्, n. (for शण-सूत्र),
hempen cord or thread, packthread.
सणहाष सणहाष, N. of a place.

सण्डिश सण्डिश, अस्, m. (= सन्-दंश), a
pair of tongs or nippers.

सण्डी सण्-डी (सम्-डी), cl. 1. 4. A. -डयते,
-डीयते, -डयितुम्, to fly together.

सण्-डीन, अम्, n. flying together, one of the
modes of flight attributed to birds; alighting from a
flight, perching (as a bird).
